title: Scene-Shift Choreographer
tagline: Steer an abstract motion ribbon on the beat, then watch the scene change reshape its route.

paper.title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators

novelty: No known implementation (not verified): this toy combines a scene-selected vector correction with beat-timed steering.
description: A fully offline 2D rhythm toy that makes a scene-dependent vector correction visible. It is a conceptual illustration, not a motion safety system.
howItWorks: A hand-authored candidate vector is steered by pointer or touch. In the protected-person scene, a simple 2D projection redirects a candidate that crosses the marked boundary toward a hand-authored safe reference vector. A pulsing beat gives timing feedback.
controls: Drag the glowing endpoint to steer; tap the stage on the beat. Use the scene switch to toggle between prop and protected-person context. Space also toggles the scene.
